GraceTechnology.Runtime: Flutter SDK stable, pinned with FVM (.fvm/flutter_sdk, .fvmrc)
GraceTechnology.Framework: Flutter with Material 3 (dark theme only), auto_route for navigation, Provider/ChangeNotifier for app state, flutter_bloc in two foreign features (profile, throttle_brake_graph)
GraceTechnology.TestingStack: flutter test driven by dart_test.yaml; tests that fetch third-party sites carry the `network` tag and are skipped by default (run with `flutter test --tags network --run-skipped`). Existing suites cover the site parsers (dg-edge, gt-sh), models and widget behaviour (daily_races_display, car_catalog, car_type_enum).
GraceTechnology.Observability: debugPrint with a class-name prefix in services and repositories, plus the Gt7AuthTrace singleton (kDebugMode-gated, masks secrets) for the PSN login flow. No remote telemetry or crash reporting.

OperationalConstraints.Constraint: Prefer existing project libraries and established repository patterns.
Network transport is package:http plus graphql for GTDB, with the http.Client injected (three legacy services still call static http.get/post; do not copy that).
Caching is manual (boolean flags and forceRefresh); there is no TTL layer.
